name: Stripe
summary: Look up customers, payments, subscriptions, and issue refunds.

auth.setup_help: Use a restricted API key with only the read (and, if you want refunds, write) permissions the agent needs. A full secret key gives an agent your whole account.

actions.name: stripe_search_customers
actions.description: Find a customer by email or name using Stripe search syntax, e.g. "email:'jane@acme.com'".

response.projection_jmespath: data[].{id: id, email: email, name: name, created: created, delinquent: delinquent}

actions.name: stripe_list_charges
actions.description: List recent charges, optionally for one customer. Amounts are in the smallest currency unit (cents).

response.projection_jmespath: data[].{id: id, amount: amount, currency: currency, status: status, paid: paid, refunded: refunded, created: created, description: description}

actions.name: stripe_list_subscriptions
actions.description: List a customer's subscriptions and their current status.

response.projection_jmespath: data[].{id: id, status: status, current_period_end: current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end: cancel_at_period_end, plan: items.data[0].price.nickname}

actions.name: stripe_create_refund
actions.description: Refund a charge, fully or partially. Amount is in the smallest currency unit; omit it to refund in full.

fields.description: Partial amount in cents; omit for a full refund.

response.projection_jmespath: {id: id, status: status, amount: amount, currency: currency}

toolset.description: Stripe: look up customers, payments and subscriptions, and issue refunds.
